title: Win AI discovery and plan for a smaller, costlier PC market
summary: Asus sees the 2027 PC market shrinking 10-15% on memory prices; some OEMs trim 2027 memory buys (TrendForce). Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries; OpenAI added agents for US e-commerce firms. Amex sees 14-year-high SMB holiday spend.

points.headline: Memory costs point to a smaller 2027 PC market and sharper promotions
points.detail: Asus expects the 2027 PC market to shrink 10-15% on memory prices, while rising inventories lead some OEMs to trim memory purchases. We should plan promo depth, mix and financing.

points.headline: AI shopping assistants are scaling, so product visibility there matters
points.detail: Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries with text shopping, and OpenAI lets businesses claim ChatGPT profiles. We should check how our products and store appear in AI answers.

points.headline: Small-business buyers are spending more this holiday season
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spend, and Acer reported a five-year monthly revenue high on commercial PCs. We should push business bundles, financing and bulk offers.

points.headline: Marketplaces are tightening their grip on electronics sales
points.detail: Amazon is pushing Cyber 5 exclusives and AI personalization, and JD.com is seeking to lead European electronics retail via Ceconomy. We should review our listings, offers and channel terms.
